premises.static_upper_grid: Launch the runtime's 332 row-tile upper bound and mark its 85 unused row tiles with -1 sentinels instead of launching only the 247 actual layer-1 row tiles.
premises.launch_bounds_min_blocks_2: Change only __launch_bounds__(128, 1) to __launch_bounds__(128, 2) on the production 64-column x 64-row qmicro body to request two resident workgroups per compute unit.
premises.invariants: Identical byte-neutral qmicro weights, activation layout, output grid ownership, ordered K32 dot/F32 accumulation, BF16 stores, and runtime-visible results.

correctness.red: The rows64/qmicro/lb2 case failed because the production wrapper had no min-blocks-2 specialization.
correctness.green: The uneven/empty-expert CPU-reference gate passed after adding the specialization.

static_upper_grid_leaf.interpretation: The sentinel workgroups return cheaply enough that the two launch geometries are timing-equivalent. Host-side exact-grid construction is not a material Q6 leaf cost.

decision.gate: A scheduler-only candidate must preserve exactness, change the intended machine schedule, and produce a repeatable actual-leaf improvement.
decision.action: Remove the static-upper harness mode and launch-bounds-2 HIP export, wrapper selector, test parameter, and harness mode. Keep the exact runtime grid and production launch bounds.
